page_title: ACM 0-1 PAR | AC Milan v Parma 22/02/2026, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+8' Marco Piccinini is looking at his watch and immediately ends this match.
90+8' Alexis Saelemaekers (AC Milan) has a shot blocked from inside the box.
90+7' A decent cross into the box is met first time by Zachary Athekame (AC Milan), but his powerful goalbound effort is superbly blocked by a defender.
90+7' Adrien Rabiot (AC Milan) whips a promising cross into the box, but the opposition's defence intercepts the ball.
90+6' What a goal-scoring opportunity! Rafael Leao (AC Milan) makes a good run into the box to meet a cross and fires the ball in on goal, but the shot is amazingly blocked by a defender.
90+6' The referee blows his whistle as Hans Nicolussi Caviglia (Parma) was too aggressive in his challenge. AC Milan will take a free kick.
90+5' Zachary Athekame (AC Milan) delivers a fine lofted cross into the penalty area, but it's cleared by an opposing player.
90+3' That will be all from Mateo Pellegrino who is being replaced by the fresh legs of Nahuel Estevez (Parma).
90+2' Zachary Athekame (AC Milan) was too forceful with his tackle and Marco Piccinini interrupted the game to signal a free kick. Parma have a free kick.
90+2' Christopher Nkunku (AC Milan) sends a cross into the box, but Edoardo Corvi comes off his line to gather the ball.
90+1' Niclas Fullkrug (AC Milan) receives a sweet pass inside the box, but his effort on goal is blocked by the defender. Now AC Milan have a corner.
90' There will be a minimum of 7 min. of added time.
90' Davide Bartesaghi (AC Milan) delivers a promising cross into the box, but it's cleared.
86' Massimiliano Allegri has decided to make a change. Zachary Athekame (AC Milan) replaces Fikayo Tomori.
86' The referee signals that it is time for a substitution and Christopher Nkunku (AC Milan) is coming onto the pitch as Ardon Jashari cannot continue after picking up an injury.
85' Marco Piccinini sticks with his original decision after the VAR review. No infringement and the goal stands!
81' Parma score a goal, but referee Marco Piccinini has now indicated he wants to check if the goal can stand using VAR!
80' 0 - 1 Emanuele Valeri takes over corner duties and expertly finds Mariano Troilo (Parma), who jumps highest and coolly plants a bullet header into the back of the net. The score is now 0:1.
80' Emanuele Valeri (Parma) is heading toward the corner flag to take the set piece.
79' Sascha Britschgi (Parma) crosses the ball into the box, but one of the defending players averts the threat. Parma get a corner.
76' A substitution has been made. Gabriel Strefezza goes off and Jacob Ondrejka (Parma) comes on.

75' The free kick is whipped into the box and finds Strahinja Pavlovic (AC Milan), who plants a header just wide of the left post from close range. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Parma.

75' The game is interrupted. Emanuele Valeri (Parma) has violated the rules in the battle for the ball. No protests or gestures are being made as he is quite aware of what he did. AC Milan are given an advantage. They have a free kick.
71' Adrien Rabiot (AC Milan) robs an opponent of the ball and explodes in anger when Marco Piccinini blows for a foul. There is a free kick near the sideline to Parma.
71' Rafael Leao (AC Milan) once again attempts to send a defence-splitting pass, but the opposition's defence is alert and intercepts the ball.

68' Hans Nicolussi Caviglia (Parma) decides to have a direct shot at goal from the free kick, but the ball goes high over the top of the crossbar. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for AC Milan.
67' Marco Piccinini blows the whistle, Ardon Jashari (AC Milan) is penalised for a foul. Parma earn a free kick.
65' Strahinja Pavlovic (AC Milan) slides a pass forward, but one of the defenders cuts it out.

64' Rafael Leao (AC Milan) takes a nice first touch to control a cross and shoots at goal from near the penalty spot, but his effort only hits the right-hand post! The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Parma.
64' The resulting corner from Luka Modric (AC Milan) is cleared by the defence.
63' Luka Modric (AC Milan) will take the corner.
62' Massimiliano Allegri prepares a substitution. Christian Pulisic is replaced by Niclas Fullkrug (AC Milan).
62' The substitution is prepared. Strahinja Pavlovic (AC Milan) joins the action as a substitute, replacing Pervis Estupinan.
59' Carlos Cuesta has decided to substitute Adrian Bernabe Garcia and he is replaced by Hans Nicolussi Caviglia (Parma).
59' The substitution has been made. Oliver Sorensen (Parma) has replaced Christian Ordonez.
58' Adrian Bernabe Garcia (Parma) releases a decent shot towards the middle of the goal from the edge of the box, but it's comfortably gathered by Mike Maignan.
57' Koni De Winter (AC Milan) commits a rough challenge and Marco Piccinini blows his whistle for a foul. It's a free kick to Parma in a dangerous position.
56' Alexis Saelemaekers (AC Milan) crosses into the box from near the side line, but he doesn't connect as he wanted and it's cleared by the well-organized defence.
56' Alexis Saelemaekers (AC Milan) flights in the cross, but the defender is alert and clears to safety.
56' Luka Modric (AC Milan) takes the ball to the corner flag and sends it into the box.
55' Ardon Jashari (AC Milan) races towards goal but the defender gets back well to make a challenge. The ball goes out for a corner. AC Milan can continue in their attacking effort.
54' Christian Pulisic (AC Milan) reacts well to latch onto a rebound inside the box, but his shot is well blocked.
52' Rafael Leao (AC Milan) receives a yellow card for infringement.
52' The game is interrupted as Fikayo Tomori (AC Milan) is flagged offside.
51' Fikayo Tomori (AC Milan) produces a poor pass. He attempts to get the ball into the box but it's hacked away.
48' Mariano Troilo (Parma) can't expect anything else than a yellow card for his hard tackle. And a yellow it is. Marco Piccinini didn't think twice about pulling it out of his pocket.
48' Enrico Delprato (Parma) fails to find any of his teammates inside the box as his pass is blocked.
47' Alexis Saelemaekers (AC Milan) sends a pass into the box, but his attempt is thwarted and cleared.
46' The whistle blows and Marco Piccinini starts the second half.
45+5' The match has reached half-time.
45+5' Rafael Leao (AC Milan) makes a run into the box and gets on the end of a cross, but his well-taken shot crashes into a defender and is cleared away.
45+2' Rafael Leao (AC Milan) shows too much aggression while trying to break free from his opponent and the referee blows his whistle for a foul. A free kick has been awarded to Parma.
45+2' The free kick is taken by Luka Modric (AC Milan), but ball is cleared.
45+1' Adrian Bernabe Garcia (Parma) gives away a foul for a clumsy challenge. Referee Marco Piccinini saw the whole situation. AC Milan will take a free kick near the side line.
45' The fourth official shows 4 min. of added time.

45' Adrian Bernabe Garcia (Parma) tries to hit a shot towards goal from long range, but he miskicks the ball and it flies high over the crossbar. The ball goes out of play and AC Milan will have a goal kick.
42' Chance! Christian Pulisic (AC Milan) took a nice pass in his stride in the box, but scuffed his shot just wide of the left post. The ball goes out of play and Parma will have a goal kick.
41' A pass into the penalty area from Christian Pulisic (AC Milan) is intercepted by the defence.
39' Alexis Saelemaekers (AC Milan) unleashes a shot, but it's well wide of the left-hand post. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Parma.
37' Emanuele Valeri (Parma) attempts to find his teammate with a pass from outside the box, but the opposition's defence is quick to react and thwarts the attack.
34' The linesman raises his flag. Lautaro Valenti (Parma) is adjudged offside.
34' A cross from a mid-range free kick, taken by Parma, is intercepted by one of the defenders.
32' Marco Piccinini shows a yellow card to Alexis Saelemaekers (AC Milan) for a tough tackle.
32' Emanuele Valeri (Parma) attempts to send a low pass into the box from the edge of the penalty area, but the opposition's defence knocks the ball to safety.
31' Marco Piccinini interrupts the game. One of the players from AC Milan won the ball, but his effort is adjudged unfair. Free kick. Parma will probably just try to cross the ball in from here.

31' Rafael Leao (AC Milan) displays brilliant awareness inside the six-yard box and leaps high to meet the free kick. He tries to put his header into the top of the net, but Edoardo Corvi keeps the ball out.
30' Mandela Keita (Parma) commits an ugly tackle on his opponent, but there is no caution from the referee. AC Milan win a free kick.
29' Marco Piccinini blows his whistle. Gabriel Strefezza (Parma) commits a foul after dangerous play. AC Milan have a free kick.
28' Another attempt to send the ball beyond the defence by Davide Bartesaghi (AC Milan) is thwarted and cleared to safety.
28' AC Milan keep possession of the ball by producing short passes and one-two passes from player to player.
26' Christian Pulisic (AC Milan) makes a driving run into the box but he cannot work any space for a shot. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Parma.
25' Adrien Rabiot (AC Milan) sends a teasing cross into the area, but Edoardo Corvi intercepts the ball.
24' Alexis Saelemaekers (AC Milan) slides a pass forward, but one of the defenders cuts it out.

22' Ardon Jashari (AC Milan) latches on to a precise defence-splitting pass and fires a nice strike from a promising distance towards the middle of the goal. Edoardo Corvi has a clear sight of it and makes a comfortable save.

20' Mateo Pellegrino (Parma) makes an overly-aggressive challenge and Marco Piccinini blows his whistle for a foul. AC Milan win a free kick and will be able to apply some pressure on the opposition goal.
20' A cross is clipped into the penalty area by Alexis Saelemaekers (AC Milan) but poses no threat.

18' Ardon Jashari (AC Milan) gets on the end of a pass and tries a shot from the edge of the box, but it's a wild attempt that goes well wide of the right post. The ball goes out of play and Parma will have a goal kick.
18' A pass by Christian Pulisic (AC Milan) ends up in no man's land, and the attacking effort comes to an end.

17' A sweeping move ends with a pass to Ardon Jashari (AC Milan) inside the box. He lets fly low towards the middle of the goal, but Edoardo Corvi was watching it all the way and makes a comfortable save.
15' Another attempt to send the ball beyond the defence by Adrian Bernabe Garcia (Parma) is thwarted and cleared to safety.

14' Adrien Rabiot (AC Milan) should know this behaviour is beyond the rules. He was too careless with his challenge and left Marco Piccinini no option but to blow his whistle. It's a free kick to Parma, but they probably won't attempt a direct shot on goal from here.
13' Adrian Bernabe Garcia (Parma) is unable to feed a through ball into the path of his teammates. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for AC Milan.
12' Edoardo Corvi (Parma) has picked up a minor injury, but it looks like he will be able to continue.
11' Ruben Loftus-Cheek (AC Milan) is unable to continue after that nasty looking head injury. Massimiliano Allegri ushers on Ardon Jashari to replace him.
8' The game is interrupted. Ruben Loftus-Cheek (AC Milan) suffers a horrific injury!
8' Edoardo Corvi (Parma) is clearly asking for some medical attention with his painful gestures. The extent of his injury is yet to be discovered.
8' Marco Piccinini blows his whistle and it's Ruben Loftus-Cheek (AC Milan) who is penalised for an offensive foul. Good decision by the referee. Parma have a free kick.
7' Alexis Saelemaekers (AC Milan) delivers a lovely cross into the penalty area. Nevertheless, an opposition defender is alert and averts the danger with a brilliant clearance.
3' Enrico Delprato (Parma) is caught offside!
3' A corner kick by Parma is thwarted by the well prepared Mike Maignan (AC Milan).

2' Mateo Pellegrino (Parma) takes a first-time shot inside the box after latching onto a nice lofted pass, but the effort is blocked and spins away to safety. Parma have been awarded a corner kick. The referee and one of his assistants both point at the corner flag.
1' The referee blows his whistle and we are underway.
Parma will kick the game off.
